title: In Bolus calculator the insulin coloring in dark blue is hard to read
symptom: In the Bolus calculator, the insulin value (IE) is colored dark blue, which is hard to read on a dark background, especially for visually impaired users. The contrast between the blue text and the black background is insufficient.
evidence_quote: if you have a dark background, then the blue of the insulin value is hard to read for visually impaired users.
